summary: Iteration 8 — AUTH + MEMBERSHIP fully validated. Backend: 28/28 pytest passed (backend_iteration8_test.py). Auth: register (200 + token/user), duplicate email → 409, short password (<6) → 400, login invalid → 401, login valid → 200, GET /auth/me without/invalid token → 401, with token → 200, /auth/logout invalidates the token (subsequent /auth/me → 401), /auth/forgot returns {sent:true, reset_token} for known email and just {sent:true} for unknown email (no user enumeration), /auth/reset with the token + new password (>=6) succeeds AND invalidates all old sessions (verified old bearer → 401), reused reset token → 400, login with new password succeeds. Demo account TEST_DEMO_EMAIL / TEST_PASSWORD logs in successfully. Membership: GET /billing/plans (public) returns trial_days:14 and both pro_monthly (A$19.99 aud) & pro_yearly (A$199 aud) with server-side amounts; GET /billing/membership without token → 401, with token returns plan/status/is_active/expires_at/auto_renew; POST /billing/checkout with plan:'hackerplan' → 400 (amount NOT taken from client); POST /billing/checkout requires auth (401); POST /billing/checkout {plan:'pro_monthly', origin_url} returns 200 with valid Stripe checkout url + session_id and persists a payment_transactions row; GET /billing/status/{sid} returns payment_status/status/membership; POST /billing/cancel sets membership_status='canceled'. Regression: /dashboard/stats, /dashboard/upcoming, /dashboard/outstanding, /clients, /invoices, /receipts, /expenses all 200 AND are still callable WITHOUT a bearer token per spec (single-owner MVP). Frontend (390x844 mobile web): unauth user visiting / is redirected to /login. Demo login lands on Command dashboard (testID=dashboard-screen). Register screen creates new account (test_ui_<epoch>@ndis.app) and immediately lands on dashboard. Forgot-password screen shows the dev-only reset code (testID=dev-reset-token) after submit and reveals reset-token + reset-password + reset-submit inputs. Account → Membership row (testID=account-membership) opens membership screen (testID=membership-screen) with the Free/14-day-trial status card, and BOTH plan cards testID=plan-pro_monthly ($19.99/month) and testID=plan-pro_yearly ($199/year with BEST VALUE SAVE 17% badge). Tapping subscribe-pro_monthly triggers POST /api/billing/checkout → 200 with a Stripe checkout URL (no crash; navigation to stripe was intercepted to avoid entering card data, per instructions). PIN quick-unlock modal (testID=account-pin) opens with keypad testIDs setpin-0..9 and setpin-save; saving '1234' persists to localStorage ndis_pin and swaps the row to 'Change quick-unlock PIN' + 'Remove PIN lock' (testID=account-remove-pin) without any crash. Bottom tab bar with exactly 5 tabs (Command / Clients / Scan / Invoices / Planner) remains visible on /account, /membership, /vault, /credentials — no leaked 'Account' / 'Membership' / 'Client' / 'Invoice' tabs (verified via _layout.tsx href:null pattern and by DOM label extraction).

minor.issue: Response includes the reset_token in cleartext when email delivery is not configured — intentional per code comment for dev/testing, but this is documented as a follow-up for production. Field 'email_delivery_configured':false is present to flag it.
No email format validation — accepts any non-empty string as email. Consider EmailStr from pydantic to reject 'foo' style values.

ui_bugs.issue: On web preview, tapping the 'Log out' row triggers react-native Alert.alert('Log out', ...) but no confirmation modal is visible in the DOM and no window.confirm dialog is emitted — the tap becomes a no-op on web. Direct call to api.authLogout via backend works (backend test passes) but the Account-screen web logout is broken. Native (Expo Go / iOS / Android) should still work because Alert.alert is a native construct. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/account.tsx:25-29.

issues: The status card gradient on Free tier uses colors.surfaceSecondary for both stops → effectively a flat panel (no gradient). Consider a subtle brand-tinted gradient to differentiate from plan cards. Cosmetic only.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props deprecated on web — use 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking, carried from prior iterations.
'props.pointerEvents' deprecated — use style.pointerEvents. Non-blocking, carried from prior iterations.
'Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web. Adding a listener will have no effect.' — expected on web preview, native builds unaffected.

action_items: Web-only bug: Alert.alert-based logout on Account screen is a no-op on react-native-web. Replace with a custom confirmation modal (or Platform.OS === 'web' ? window.confirm(...) : Alert.alert(...)) so that /account → 'Log out' works on the web preview, then reroutes to /(auth)/login.
(Optional) Add EmailStr validation to RegisterBody / LoginBody / ForgotBody in server.py for proper email format checks.
(Optional) Once an email provider key is available (Resend/SendGrid), stop returning reset_token in the /auth/forgot response and mail it instead. Guard behind an env var check.
(Cosmetic) On /membership, differentiate the Free status card visually — the current gradient collapses to the same base color.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py — auth section is clean: bcrypt password hashing (72-byte pre-slice for compatibility), server-generated session tokens via secrets.token_urlsafe, TTL index on user_sessions.expires_at (Mongo auto-expires), user_sessions.session_token unique index, users.email unique index. get_current_user is a proper FastAPI dependency returning the user doc (with _id stripped). Google session exchange verifies via Emergent's session-data URL.

backend/server.py — /auth/reset correctly (a) rejects passwords <6, (b) rejects invalid/used/expired tokens with 400, (c) hashes new password and marks the token used, (d) deletes ALL user_sessions for that user (verified: old token → 401 after reset). Good practice.

backend/server.py — /billing/checkout: prices are read from server-side PLANS dict only; client 'amount' is never accepted. Invalid plan → 400 verified. payment_transactions row is created with processed:false and idempotently promoted to processed:true in _apply_paid_membership. Uses emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout (Emergent proxy with sk_test_emergent).

backend/server.py — /billing/status calls sc.get_checkout_status and, when payment_status=='paid', calls _apply_paid_membership which safely extends membership_expires_at either from now or from the current expiry (whichever is greater) by plan.period_days. Good idempotency.

backend/server.py — Data endpoints (clients/invoices/receipts/expenses/dashboard/*) are intentionally NOT behind get_current_user per spec — verified they return 200 without an Authorization header. Documented in test_credentials.md.

frontend/src/auth/AuthContext.tsx — restore-on-mount pulls token from SecureStore (native) / localStorage (web), calls api.authMe(), sets user + hasPin, and forces locked:true on cold start when a PIN exists. AppState listener re-locks on background resume when hasPin. Google web redirect handler reads ?session_id or #session_id and exchanges via api.authGoogleSession. Clean.

frontend/app/_layout.tsx — RootNav effect correctly redirects unauthenticated users to /(auth)/login and authenticated users away from (auth) → /(tabs). LockScreen overlays only when user && locked. Loading spinner while restore is in flight.

frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx — 5 real tabs + href:null screens for account, membership, vault, credentials, reports, templates, settings, ndis-codes, notes, shift, client, invoice — this is the correct Expo Router pattern to keep the bottom bar mounted while hiding the entries from the tab bar. Confirmed live on /membership + /account.

frontend/app/(tabs)/membership.tsx — loads plans + membership in parallel, handles ?session_id return from Stripe by polling billing/status up to 6× at 2s, uses server-side prices only (no client amount), disables the current plan button, offers cancel button (with confirm Alert). NOTE: on web the checkout URL is opened via window.location.href — correct; on native it opens WebBrowser then polls after the in-app browser closes.

rca_of_issue: Logout-on-web bug RCA: react-native-web's Alert.alert on multi-button configuration is known to be inconsistent — depending on the RN-Web version, it may render a custom in-DOM modal, may fall back to window.confirm, or (as observed here) become a no-op silently. Reproduction: on web preview, /account → tap 'Log out' row → nothing happens visibly, and the auth session persists. Backend logout endpoint itself is correct (verified by direct pytest). Mitigation: gate with Platform.OS === 'web' and use `if (window.confirm('You'll need to sign in again.')) await logout()` OR render a custom Modal with two Pressables. Same pattern applies to the 'Cancel membership' Alert in membership.tsx.
